_doc: 剪辑合成师页面上的推算口径(app/core/post_production.py)：情绪张力曲线每镜怎么打分、配乐库曲目和这部剧的匹配度、成片大小按什么码率估。张力信号词沿用 scene_tension.json 的词表。 第 6 阶段发给音频模型的配乐、环境音提示词也在这里(music_prompt 里的 {style}、{genre}、{palette} 换成项目的导演风格、题材和题材配器)。
music_prompt: {style} {genre} short drama cinematic score, {palette}, emotion arc with restrained opening, rising tension, clear climax and gentle resolution, instrumental only, leave space for dialogue
music_language_note: 配乐统一风格：题材定了配乐基调就定了，全剧一套音乐语言。music_palettes 按题材(model_gateway.get_genre 的 id)给配器，填进 music_prompt 的 {palette}；题材只认出 general 时按全剧的类型聚类(frame_handoff.show_cluster，A–G)查 music_cluster_palettes；第一次出配乐时整句提示词锁进项目(6_music_language)，以后各集都用这一句，不再随集变。
music_series_suffix: the same musical language for every episode of this series: same instrumentation, same key centre and tempo family, same recurring main motif

music_palettes.xianxia: orchestral strings driven by heavy taiko and war drums, guzheng and dizi accents, brass swelling on every comeback and turnaround
music_palettes.wuxia: erhu and guzheng over low strings, taiko drums under the fights, sparse bamboo flute in the quiet moments
music_palettes.palace_intrigue: guqin and pipa over restrained low strings, slow tension pulses, sparse court percussion
music_palettes.time_travel: light orchestral with guzheng and pizzicato strings, strings swelling at each twist
music_palettes.male_counterattack: hybrid orchestral with heavy drums and sub-bass hits, triumphant brass on every payoff
music_palettes.rebirth_revenge: dark strings and a cold piano motif, heavy drums building into cathartic payoffs
music_palettes.mystery: low drones and a ticking pulse, muted piano, dissonant string clusters
music_palettes.horror: dissonant strings and low drones, a sparse eerie music box, sudden stingers
music_palettes.romance: piano and warm strings, soft pads, a light pop rhythm
music_palettes.family: intimate piano and cello, gentle acoustic guitar
music_palettes.campus: acoustic guitar and light piano, soft indie-pop drums
music_palettes.food: warm acoustic guitar, light hand percussion, gentle piano
music_palettes.military: snare marches, low brass and epic strings
music_palettes.sports: driving electronic beats with rock drums and power chords
music_palettes.sci_fi: synth pads, pulsing electronic bass, cinematic hits
music_palettes.comedy: pizzicato strings, playful woodwinds, bouncy percussion
music_palettes.overseas_us: dark cinematic pop, synth bass under brooding strings
music_palettes.overseas_other: regional percussion and plucked strings over cinematic strings
music_palettes.interactive: suspenseful hybrid score with clear pulses at each choice point
music_palettes.car: sleek electronic pulses, synth bass and modern drums
music_palettes.default: cinematic strings with steady drums and a clear main motif

music_cluster_palettes.A: piano and warm strings with a modern pop pulse, cello for the hurt, drums only on the payoffs
music_cluster_palettes.B: guqin, erhu and pipa over low strings, taiko and war drums under the confrontations, a lone dizi in the silences
music_cluster_palettes.C: orchestral strings driven by heavy taiko and war drums, guzheng and dizi accents, brass swelling on every comeback and turnaround
music_cluster_palettes.D: hybrid orchestral with heavy drums and sub-bass hits, driving percussion through the action
music_cluster_palettes.E: low drones and a ticking pulse, muted piano, dissonant string clusters
music_cluster_palettes.F: synth pads, pulsing electronic bass, cinematic hits
music_cluster_palettes.G: pizzicato strings, playful woodwinds, bouncy percussion

ambience_prompt: cinematic short drama room tone and environmental ambience, subtle cloth movement, footsteps and natural space, no music, no speech
